log: --- force random ticks on the farmland and crops (the world's real tick code) ---

eval: (async()=>{const g=__game,w=g.world,[x0,y,z0]=window.__F; let ticks=0; const done=()=>[-1,0,1].every(dx=>w.getBlock(x0+dx,y,z0-2)===128); for(let dx=-1;dx<=1;dx++) for(let i=0;i<10;i++) w._tickFarmland(w.getBlock(x0+dx,y-1,z0-2), x0+dx, y-1, z0-2, Math.random); const soil=[-1,0,1].map(dx=>g.debug.blockName(x0+dx,y-1,z0-2)); while(!done() && ticks<5000){ ticks++; for(let dx=-1;dx<=1;dx++){ const id=w.getBlock(x0+dx,y,z0-2); if (id>=121&&id<=128) w._tickCrop(id, x0+dx, y, z0-2, Math.random); else return {error:'not a crop at '+dx+': '+g.debug.blockName(x0+dx,y,z0-2)}; } } await g.debug.frames(10); return {soil, randomTicksPerCrop:ticks, crops:[-1,0,1].map(dx=>g.debug.blockName(x0+dx,y,z0-2))}})()
